image_description: A high-angle, close-up shot of a European fire salamander (Salamandra salamandra) resting on a bed of dark, wet forest debris consisting of pine needles and decaying leaves. The salamander's body is oriented diagonally across the frame, displaying its characteristic glossy black skin with irregular, bright yellow spots and bands. The environment appears moist and natural.
